Hi, I’m Ting-Yen (Ella) Chang. I recently received my M.S. from the Institute of Intelligent Systems, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU).
My research focused on the security of large language models. I’m also interested in AI agents and generative models.
Education NYCU, M.S. in Intelligent Systems (2024 – 2026) NTHU, B.S. in Interdisciplinary Program of Education (2020 – 2024) HSNU (2017 – 2020) Experience DeepCAT Lab, NYCU, Research Assistant (2024 – 2026)
Advisor: Dr. Tzer-Jen Wei
Thesis: Semantic Disruption Attacks on LLMs via Invisible Character Injection
Industry collaboration with ITRI: accelerating Stable Video Diffusion with cache-based methods ITRI, Digital Twin Engineer Intern (2025)
AEB testing in the CARLA simulator SUNNET Technology, Development Engineer Intern (2024)
